title: Civilisational futures
learning_outcomes: Explain demographic technological ecological drivers in the context of civilisational futures.
Compare and distinguish alternative scenarios in the context of civilisational futures.
Apply distributional trade-offs in the context of civilisational futures.
Evaluate and justify decisions about robust strategy in the context of civilisational futures.

lessons.title: Demographic technological ecological drivers
lessons.outcome: Explain demographic technological ecological drivers in the context of civilisational futures.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving demographic technological ecological drivers; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to country futures memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain demographic technological ecological drivers from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of demographic technological ecological drivers; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Alternative scenarios
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish alternative scenarios in the context of civilisational futures.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving alternative scenarios; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to country futures memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain alternative scenarios from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of alternative scenarios; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Distributional trade-offs
lessons.outcome: Apply distributional trade-offs in the context of civilisational futures.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving distributional trade-offs; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to country futures memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain distributional trade-offs from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of distributional trade-offs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Robust strategy
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about robust strategy in the context of civilisational futures.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving robust strategy; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to country futures memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain robust strategy from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of robust strategy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of demographic technological ecological drivers; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of alternative scenarios; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of distributional trade-offs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of robust strategy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Historian, economist, legal or policy specialist as appropriate.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
